facts.text: Sit down, Jimmy. Eat something and don't lose the money this time.
facts.why: Printed in quote marks as Pando's words, but it is not a line from the film. It works as a note in his voice, since Jimmy loses his ten grand at Bondi.
facts.fix: Sit down, Jimmy. Eat something, and keep your hands on my ten grand this time.

fix_note.text: Sit down, Jimmy. Eat something, and keep your hands on my ten grand this time.

facts.text: the gangster's crew killing time at his place
facts.why: No scene shows Pando's crew killing time at his place. The plot has Jimmy returning to Pando's office, where the gang nearly kills him again.
facts.fix: the gang waiting at Pando's office

facts.text: Jimmy's feed before that swim at Bondi.
facts.why: Jimmy swims at Bondi while street kids lift Pando's ten grand; no feed is shown beforehand.
facts.fix: Eat up before Jimmy's swim costs him ten grand.

facts.text: the family house out in the suburbs
facts.why: The suburban house in the plot is Deirdre's, where she lives as a suburban housewife and sets up the bank job. Jimmy's brother is dead and no family roast is shown.
facts.fix: Deirdre's family house out in the suburbs
